legend: The Island of the Dolls (Xochimilco, Mexico, legend)
lines: Xochimilco, south of Mexico City: a tiny island hidden among the canals.
Hundreds of dolls hang from its trees, with missing eyes and missing arms.
Legend says a man named Julián moved here alone, long ago.
He feared a restless spirit lingered by the water.
So he hung dolls from every tree to keep her calm.
Visitors say the dolls whisper and turn their heads at night.
In two thousand one, Julián was found in the very water he feared.
Today, the dolls still watch from the branches.
Would you dare to spend one night there? What do you think?
title: The Island of Dolls: Why Hundreds of Dolls Hang From Every Tree #shorts
description:
On a tiny island near Mexico City, hundreds of weathered dolls hang from the trees. Legend says they were hung to calm a restless spirit.
